给医院影像科与信息部门写AI证据简报，决定是否进入本地静默验证。

invariants: Audience context and intended action precede format selection
A communication plan is not an abstract submission poster file publication or release
Every material claim resolves to a frozen source artifact and scientific owner
Simpler wording never raises certainty causality generalisability utility or deployment status
Results interpretation recommendation and proposed action remain distinct
Current venue channel embargo and disclosure rules are verified live
Meeting acceptance does not validate the scientific result
Plain-language readability scores do not prove comprehension
Patient and public material separates aggregate research from individual clinical results
Clinical evidence briefs do not function as guidelines or deployment authorization
Policy options are not mandates and disclose values interests and local context
Press and social copy preserves study design population scale uncertainty and limitations
Statistical significance does not mean importance accuracy safety or benefit
A citation is not copyright permission and open access is not unrestricted reuse
Copyright license attribution consent governance privacy and embargo are separate gates
PowerPoint crops black bars and masks do not permanently remove PHI
Radiology images retain modality acquisition orientation laterality transformations and provenance
Public display is not a diagnostic display and does not imply diagnostic fidelity
Accessibility requires human review and automated success is not a certificate
The skill does not give patient-specific advice submit publish or replace release authorities
PPTX remains owned by radiology-paper2ppt and standalone figures by radiology-figure
